candidateBlurb: Twenty-one years in local government. Owns four identical blue ties. Has strong opinions about a roundabout and will share them unprompted.

objectives.label: Don't break the candidate (morale above 25 on election day)

keepMessage: Bramley keeps the seat warm and you keep the retainer. His agent sends a bottle of something regrettable and a note reading 'onwards'.
sackMessage: You are informed by text message, at 11:40pm, while the returning officer is still talking. Bramley's people have already changed the office locks.

nextJob.sting: Your new client ran unsuccessfully for the same council seat in 2009, 2013 and 2017. He has a PowerPoint. It is forty slides long and it is called MOMENTUM.
